title: DLC Skill Blueprints
subtitle: Marvel’s Midnight Suns
summary: Built ability Blueprints for four DLC heroes, connected animation, effects, and UI, and debugged movement, targeting, and state issues.
description: I implemented abilities for four DLC heroes and selected enemies, handling Blueprint configuration, presentation, and debugging.

cover.alt: Deadpool performing a fiery attack in Marvel’s Midnight Suns
cover.label: DLC ability gameplay

ownership: Implemented abilities for four DLC heroes and selected enemies using the client’s rules, values, and existing framework.
Integrated animation, effects, UI, and cleanup, completing the flow from target selection to damage resolution.
Used Blueprint breakpoints to resolve character movement, target filtering, duplicate UI, and special-enemy state issues.
evidence: Gameplay from the Marvel’s Midnight Suns DLC.

sections.title: Deadpool’s ability sequence
sections.intro: For Burning Sensation, I connected movement toward the target, animation, the background mask, hit reactions, fire effects, and UI, then restored the normal battle view at the end.
steps: Approach and face the selected target
Start the mask and attack animation
Drive hit reactions with animation notifies
Resolve damage once after the attack sequence
Clear effects and finish the skill

sections.title: Fixing Deadpool’s movement
sections.intro: Deadpool’s movement was still incorrect after adjusting Root Motion. Blueprint breakpoints led me to character-specific position handling in the parent Blueprint.
paragraphs: A general refactor was outside the DLC schedule. I added a Deadpool-specific branch to fix his movement while keeping the existing handling for other characters.

points.title: Target filtering
points.text: Fixed a filter that allowed invalid targets, causing an ability to animate without its intended gameplay effect.

points.title: Duplicate UI
points.text: Removed duplicate calls in the child ability after confirming that the parent Blueprint already handled the UI.

points.title: Enemy state
points.text: Fixed a special enemy’s taunt animation state and completed the relevant ability configuration.

outcomes: The hero and enemy abilities I implemented shipped with the DLC.
Resolved movement compatibility, invalid targeting, duplicate UI, and special-enemy state issues.
